access_rule_inventory.rule: Accept any clear heading architecture that retrieves the meaning and source treatments below. Listed names are routes, not interchangeable substitutes for distinct claims. A broad umbrella alone does not satisfy a separately stated facet or reader task.

A route must retrieve the stated meaning and qualifications. Main fields include the retained obligations; unweighted facets add no denominator. A listed name alone is insufficient. Eligible captions identify literal topics only; graph interiors and keys are excluded.
Accept a clear route to the captioned map/theme on225. Do not require or credit internal map labels, symbols, shaded areas or routes as substantive evidence under this record.

access_rule_reading: Each distinct rule was read. Clear retrieval of meaning and qualifications is required; enumerated routes are not a closed string-matching vocabulary, and a matching broad name does not satisfy a distinct facet.
